page.overview:
Who is Belarien?

Belarien is a close friend of Prince Tyrion, having been there with him across many battles (and having the scars to prove it).

Atop the Sapphire Gate of Lothern, Belarien would later die defending Phoenix King Finubar from the poisoned blade of a Dark Elf Assassin. Finubar, Korhil and his White Lions had been frozen in ice by sorcery, and though the poison would prove potent enough to kill him a dozen times over, Belarien jumped between his king and the assassin's dagger, taking the blow square in the chest, and in full view of Tyrion.
